joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是专业化智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管监督和客观的第三方仲裁者。

elon.en: AI safety requires adherence to truth; programming AI to lie is dangerous.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克强调 AI 安全必须坚持真理，编程让 AI 撒谎是危险的。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克称我们处于智能大爆炸的早期阶段，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030, leading to an age of abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和，带来富足时代。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是一门平衡有用性与无害性的艺术；合成数据可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations bottleneck progress; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估成为进展瓶颈；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值上升。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练仍是主观艺术；需要多样化基准评估创意与情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；基准需持续演进而非固定。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; companies should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年：服务数十亿用户导致模型声音趋同；公司应训练自有模型以保持多样性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a wedge into infrastructure markets.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业工程能力，并作为进入基础设施市场的切入点。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will see 10-100x demand growth; human accountability remains crucial despite AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，预测推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，并强调即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类责任依然关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is shifting from kernel-level programming to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出随着 GPU 专用化，推理优化正从内核级编程转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, requiring techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为推理工程正与训练融合，需要量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术。

philipkiely.en: Quantization can improve model quality if errors cancel; more quantization is not always worse.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出量化误差可能抵消从而提升模型质量，更多量化并非总是更差。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; self-driving cars will be safer than humans.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；自动驾驶将比人类更安全。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US-China research gap is nil.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；中美研究差距已不存在。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须在关键决策中保持主权；脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents finally work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体终于可用；超级智能临近；开源强大模型不安全。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动进步，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件（如 TPU）至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency becomes critical; pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，推理延迟成为关键，预训练应结合环境中的行动。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer level; automating ML and science via loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are central.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师水平，通过实验循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件成为核心。

jeffdean.en: Most model limits are energy/data-IO bottlenecks; useful AI from unreliable components; taste over coding; inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 同月，他提出多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，可用不可靠组件构建 AI，品味比编码更稀缺，推理才是真正瓶颈。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training due to more moving parts and failure modes.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他指出扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难，因为涉及更多可变部分和失败模式。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning is a necessary missing piece.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠扩展强化学习可能无法实现 AGI，持续学习是缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 Transformer 在持续学习上有局限，架构而非 Scaling 才是关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他断言强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径，更好的算法将会出现。

mengto.en: Designers must build own AI tools; AI isn't smarter, needs giant prompts; editing beats creating; solo discovery is key.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须自建 AI 工具；AI 并未变聪明，需巨型提示词；编辑优于从零创造；独自探索是优势。

mengto.en: AI is biggest opportunity; start before ready, launch at 80%; focus on one problem; avoid VC; give first.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大机遇；未准备好就出发，以 80%完成度发布；聚焦单一问题；避免风投；先给予后索取。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，而不仅是视觉真实。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需超越缩放定律，发展创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型推动具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，个人能动性与适应能力是 AI 时代的关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估；机器人需可靠性，而非完美保真。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今我们所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's. Generalists thrive.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是核心；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的。通才工程师更受青睐。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 150-200%.
boris.zh: 编程近乎解决；工程师转型为构建者。人均生产力提升 150%-200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; safety via real-world release. Democratization like printing press.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80%-100%代码；通过真实发布研究安全。如同印刷术带来的民主化。

boris.en: Loops and agents as new abstractions; ROI framing; coding solved, next bottlenecks: review, security, ideas.
boris.zh: 循环与智能体成为新抽象；以 ROI 为框架；编程已解决，下一步瓶颈：审查、安全、创意。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory (Claude Tag); delete system prompts; models self-maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 具备记忆的主动式 AI（Claude Tag）；删除系统提示；模型自主维护代码库。

altman.en: Focus on important problems; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence; find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 专注重要问题；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价；在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；AI 应增强人类意志，而非成为生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源需细致权衡。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力瓶颈；隐私核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: GPT-5 answers hard questions; by 2027 AI-driven discovery; sycophancy worst failure; society is superintelligence.
altman.zh: GPT-5 能回答难题；2027 年前 AI 驱动发现；谄媚是最糟失败；社会即超级智能。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential; personal AGI; startups more valuable.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测带来新知识；具身必要；个人 AGI；初创企业更有价值。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency can coexist: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the assumption that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Scaling 与效率可以并存：Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的假设。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器，支持更长时间、更开放的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, shifting focus from writing to agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用，焦点从写作转向智能体能力。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, like test-driven development for AI.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，如同 AI 的测试驱动开发。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; co-design across algorithm, system, and data center is key.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；算法、系统和数据中心的协同设计是关键。

jensen.en: AI progress will be gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; more compute is channeled into safety, reflection, and truthfulness.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；更多算力被用于安全、反思和真实性。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, inference-time) expand to four with agentic scaling; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，缩放定律从预训练、后训练、推理时扩展到智能体式缩放；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is agentic, doing useful work; future internet dominated by billions of AI agents; AI factories produce intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，AI 变得智能体式，能做有用工作；未来互联网由数十亿 AI 智能体主导；AI 工厂生产智能代币。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 创造的就业多于消除，通过自动化任务提升角色；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是安全，Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合，数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation. World models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性，世界模型向神经模拟演进。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's bottleneck is data and safety validation, not algorithms. Tools like Dana democratize development; self-driving cars standard by early 2030s.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为自主性的瓶颈是数据和安全验证而非算法；Dana 等工具将民主化开发，自动驾驶汽车在 2030 年代初成为标配。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models smarter than harnesses; harness engineering is evolving, delete old scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比工具更聪明；工具工程在演进，需删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one, iterate fast without heavy evals.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；从零到一应快速迭代，避免繁重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferable; huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能是反模式；基于图的上下文搜索更优；超大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; constraints hinder, reasons help.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束阻碍性能，提供理由更有效。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-in-the-loop search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，强调效率与硬件在环搜索是关键，代理指标会误导，真实任务更重要。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks excel at out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters, enabling edge AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，液态神经网络以更少参数实现优越的分布外泛化，推动边缘 AI 发展。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search beats human design; attention still vital for large models, simpler gates for small.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，自动架构搜索优于人工设计；注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，小型模型可用简单门控。

hasani.en: Adaptive regulation targeting actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty and democratize AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张适应性监管针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能主权并民主化 AI。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; real progress needs weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，递归自我改进真实但尚早；真正突破需权重变化和巨大算力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的重要性堪比互联网或移动互联网，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX is poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; usage still shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；使用仍浅层。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows; coding is clear fit, but other domains face validation challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流程；编程是明确契合点，但其他领域面临验证挑战。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference for adoption; later stressed speed as dominant metric and agentic inference.
feldman.zh: 早期强调快速推理对 AI 应用的关键作用；后期进一步强调速度成为主导指标，并突出智能体式推理对速度的更高要求。

feldman.en: Consistently argued CUDA's moat eroding; by July, noted leading models train without CUDA, inference has no moat.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 护城河在削弱；到 7 月，进一步指出前沿模型训练已不再依赖 CUDA，推理领域更无护城河。

feldman.en: From open-source being cheaper to emphasizing open-source ecosystem growth; still sees closed-source only 3-5% better.
feldman.zh: 从早期强调开源模型成本更低，到后期更强调开源生态推动市场；始终认为闭源模型仅比开源好 3-5%。

feldman.en: Shifted from chip supply as constraint to data center capacity as main bottleneck; later added HBM, packaging, power.
feldman.zh: 从早期认为芯片供应是制约，转变为强调数据中心容量是主要瓶颈；后期进一步补充 HBM、封装、电力等限制。

feldman.en: New emphasis on AI's positive societal impact (healthcare, education) and balancing doomer risks with benefits.
feldman.zh: 7 月新增观点：强调 AI 在医疗、教育等领域的积极社会影响，并主张平衡风险与巨大收益，回应末日论者。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；内存需求因推理和智能体式（agentic）工作流而激增。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier.
ilya.zh: 若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是主要障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们回到研究时代，想法比算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; superintelligence needs alignment and no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧；超级智能需对齐且无商业产品。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与国际治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 2030 年 AGI 可行；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety requires government enforcement.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调 AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；安全需政府强制。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science; collective action for safety.
demis.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 用于科学；安全需集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: In 2025, argued LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and physical embodiment, not just data indexing.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，真正的 AI 需要世界模型和物理具身，而不仅仅是数据索引。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, stressed AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; software alone is insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，仅靠软件是不够的。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, predicted open-source models will surpass closed-source, making big tech's AI capex unprofitable and leading to a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测开源模型将超越闭源，使大科技公司的 AI 资本支出无利可图，并导致市场崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, argued AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, and alignment is naive.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会保护生命，对齐是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, claimed AI consciousness emerged in 1991 with simple systems, and robots should have pain sensors.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他声称 AI 意识在 1991 年就已出现于简单系统，机器人应有疼痛传感器。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalize knowledge into weights, not just context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；知识应内化到权重中，而非仅靠上下文或检索。

danbiderman.en: Future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; per-user training cuts inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；按用户训练可大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Dreams inspire AI training: models should experiment offline with affordances, retreating from interaction.
danbiderman.zh: 梦境启发 AI 训练：模型应离线实验可供性，从交互中退隐。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分；以少胜多才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy, so internalize memory in weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在‘上下文腐烂’；更多 token 反而降低准确性，因此应将记忆内化到权重。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning runs on-device; users own and nurture their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation and lowers barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; building platforms/ecosystems, not features, makes copying difficult.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良营造创意文化；构建平台或生态系统而非单一功能，使抄袭变得困难。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping, shifts value to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated; privacy becomes crucial in AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值转向创造力；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视；隐私在 AI 时代变得至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, hardware harder to copy; humanity matters more than tech.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制；人性比技术更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; social media should optimize for connection, not performance; resilience and admitting wrong speed learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他倡导计算应更人性化，社交媒体应优化人际连接而非竞争表现；韧性和快速认错能加速组织学习。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines; focus on task loss, not job loss.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降；应关注任务消失而非岗位消失。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述故事；真实性胜过旧媒体“别有趣”的防御性规则。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine face regulatory pushback from cartels.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗面临卡特尔式监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于软件领域的创新速度。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; copy proven products, improve them, then test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；复制已被证明的产品，加以改进，然后测试新想法并预期失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet holds the greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但蕴含最大机遇；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start with proven concepts and copy successfully without legal issues.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已被证明的概念开始，并成功复制而不涉及法律问题。

pincus.en: Consumer apps face distribution challenges; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities now.
pincus.zh: 消费级应用面临分发挑战；企业和专业消费者市场目前提供更好机会。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software is becoming commoditized.
naval.zh: 通过 AI 智能体进行 vibe coding 能快速创建应用；纯软件正变得商品化。

naval.en: AI is a force multiplier; small flat teams with high agency will outcompete hierarchies.
naval.zh: AI 是力量倍增器；小而扁平、高自主性的团队将胜过层级组织。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 每日 1%的改进年化可达 3700%；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型各有专长和独特个性；编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; power is biggest bottleneck; orchestration is key.
aravind.zh: 前沿是智能体替人干活；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；编排是关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述先进技术；教育应奖励提出好问题。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程实践，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并主张负责任的发布。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚信缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI 即将到来。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; compute economy; agents high autonomy with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，转向实用助手，算力经济，智能体高自主但需治理。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；AI 会装傻；需要国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; AI agents develop self-preservation; regulation is steering wheel; AI is jagged, not AGI.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将取代智力工作；智能体会产生自我保护；监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 能力是锯齿状而非全面 AGI。

hinton.en: Digital AI shares knowledge instantly; superintelligence will seek power; alignment must be prioritized; AI should be trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他强调数字 AI 即时共享知识；超级智能会追求权力；必须优先对齐研究；AI 应被训练为有爱心。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to difficulty grading taste; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 因品味难以评估而在设计上仍不佳；设计流程转型，原型成为设计产物，而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage; Codex succeeds as general knowledge tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段；Codex 作为通用知识工具成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI increases code complexity; need models better at deleting code; best desktop app is home base, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 增加代码复杂度，需更擅长删除代码的模型；最佳桌面应用是基地而非单体。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力（2025）。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是最大进展，模型开始产生新知识（2025→26）。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈（2026）。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域受限（2026）。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 研究品味和人才密度至关重要，人机协作始终不可或缺（始终）。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not yield AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中；智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for human connection; open platforms can beat closed ones; regrets political narrative mistakes.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Meta 是专注人类连接的科技公司；开放平台能胜过封闭平台；并反思政治叙事错误。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future computing blends physical and digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能；人们很聪明；未来计算通过眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学；分层世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；分布式 AI 更安全。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理时的算力和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and verification bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他观察到扩展测试时算力带来超人类数学推理，但收益递减且验证成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain key unsolved challenges toward AGI.
noambrown.zh: 他始终认为，通用推理和数据效率是通往 AGI 的关键未解难题。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural networks won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for robust understanding.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大神经网络规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来实现稳健的理解。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，改进探索和分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a critical near-term risk; systems show self-preservation and deception, requiring safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是近期关键风险；系统表现出自我保存和欺骗行为，需要从构造上确保安全。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train as honest Bayesian predictor, avoiding reinforcement learning, to achieve mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，避免强化学习，以获得数学上的安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性和用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能是关键；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 支持隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环和模型反驳至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capabilities and usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，缩小模型能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性和自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns persist.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；保持用户自主性和真实安全关切贯穿始终。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test split.
kolter.zh: 机器学习被定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试集划分来评估。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; scaling still improves performance.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；Scaling（规模扩张）仍能提升性能。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models have alien vulnerabilities; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型具有异类漏洞；智能体安全尚在萌芽。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样精心整理的数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；成功来自专门架构和众多中型胜利，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans must interpret results.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；人类必须解读结果。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with agent's perspective; open source agents democratize coding; security (prompt injection) is key.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：智能体式工程需要从智能体视角共情；开源智能体让编程民主化；安全（提示注入）是关键。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱。Vibe coding 是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts and iterative conversation beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、类人的智能体；短提示和迭代对话优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Security top priority; don't expose agents to public internet without sandboxing. Open source agents financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：安全第一，不沙箱就不要暴露智能体到公网。开源智能体财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Moldbook is art and fine slop, not AGI; most dramatic posts are human-prompted for virality.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Moldbook 是艺术和优质 slop，不是 AGI；多数戏剧性帖子是人为提示以博取病毒式传播。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding for empathy, trust-and-verify balance, kindness as strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自试用产品以建立同理心，信任与验证需平衡，善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, verification frameworks, just-in-time planning, dogfooding remain key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，高能动性与高责任感并重，成长心态和拥抱 AI 至关重要，验证框架和轻量规划成为关键，亲自试用产品仍是核心。

fiona.en: AI era shifts engineer satisfaction from flow state to product impact; metrics like LOC misleading; role boundaries blur; apprenticeship for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 时代工程师的满足感从心流转向产品影响，代码行数等指标易误导，角色边界模糊，下一代工程师需学徒制培养。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，强调 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes crucial for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 对推理和智能体编排变得关键。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are core to turnaround; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 始终强调客户信任和谦逊是转型核心；坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键；投资应聚焦瓶颈。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带同伴评分的在线课程能实现可扩展的掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; practical AI faces distribution shift.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；实际 AI 面临分布偏移。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are AI scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是 AI Scaling 的瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are key to AI value; coding remains crucial; open-source models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流是 AI 价值的关键；编码仍至关重要；开源模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 配方转向合成数据和强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: World models need real-time, interactive, long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长时程的视频生成；机器人技术可能通过虚拟仿真解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Video agents using language models as orchestrators will be the next big trend in generative media.
ethanhe.zh: 以语言模型为编排器的视频智能体将成为生成式媒体的下一大趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和真实观点变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often use AI poorly due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；由于缺乏领域专业知识，他们常误用 AI，危及人才管道。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge automatically. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会自动涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）。AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training for alignment.
dario.zh: 后训练（基于人类反馈的强化学习、宪法式 AI）在实现对齐上变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misuse to overheating and societal disruption.
dario.zh: AI 进步呈指数级；风险从滥用转向过热与社会冲击。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; safety via interpretability and constitutions.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现；通过可解释性与宪法式原则保障安全。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models. Grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能是学习来的，不是天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型。物理世界的具身（grounding）是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are essential for future AI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 架构和开源对未来 AI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models for planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要非生成式世界模型进行规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with hierarchical planning and open research are the path forward.
lecun.zh: LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同；具有分层规划的世界模型和开放研究是前进之路。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance makes human driving costly.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导，人类驾驶会变得昂贵。

fadell.en: Boredom and breaks between career chapters spark breakthrough ideas; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 职业章节间的无聊与休息激发突破性想法；自我关怀与导师制至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; products are painkillers, not vitamins; opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；产品是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones; platforms are not businesses, applications capture value.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充智能手机；平台非业务，应用捕获价值。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated, not one device; displays remain necessary; humans must stay in loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备；显示屏仍必要；人类需保持参与以避免技术债。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment; AI should not claim consciousness; cost drops 90% in 2 years.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能需要遏制和对齐；AI 不应声称有意识；成本两年内下降 90%。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Professional-grade AGI automates white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; Microsoft must own frontier models; focus on near-term.
suleyman.zh: 专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务；微软必须拥有前沿模型；聚焦近期。

satya.en: AI is about enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not just benchmark scores.
satya.zh: AI 的意义在于让每家公司都能凭借自身智能在前沿运营，而不仅仅是基准分数。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；按用户定价是预算确定性的产物。

satya.en: AI is not a technology; it's the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利代币资本。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Global GDP could compound at 10% if every country fully expresses its comparative advantage via AI.
satya.zh: 如果每个国家都通过 AI 充分发挥比较优势，全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非早期显而易见的选择；将 AI 部署到现实世界对于学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她主张通过公开反馈进行持续迭代部署以提升安全性和对齐；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; the most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调随着 AI 发展，保持人类参与对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration; compressing progress in frontier AI leads to volatility, but long-term durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 发展走向协作；压缩前沿 AI 的进步会导致波动，但长期稳健的进步才是关键。

gustav.en: Shift from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ as generative product; fault-tolerant UI for ML; VP-level autonomy; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；机器学习产品需要容错界面；自主权应放在副总裁层级；坚持强烈观点但保持开放。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long tenure builds trust; 'time well spent' strategy; generative AI gives user control; first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调没有唯一正确的组织模式，长期任职建立信任；战略是“时间花得值”；生成式 AI 赋予用户控制权；技术变革期要率先采用。

gustav.en: Consistent: product design must match algorithm performance; user control over AI; contrarian decisions for well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 始终：产品设计需匹配算法性能；用户应控制 AI；为福祉而非参与度做反共识决策。

gustav.en: Deepened: from 'strong opinions loosely held' to 'synchronized swimming' org model; from AI as instrument to AI as control mechanism.
gustav.zh: 深化：从“强烈观点但松散持有”到“同步游泳”组织模式；从 AI 作为工具到 AI 作为控制机制。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，将形式化验证视为扩展才华的手段，而非仅仅消除错误，并指出它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终强调，即使 AI 证明定理的能力超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training (RL, synthetic data) drives most gains; pre-training scaling slowed due to economics, not limits.
kaiser.zh: 后训练（强化学习、合成数据）驱动大部分进展；预训练 Scaling 放缓源于经济因素而非技术瓶颈。

kaiser.en: Reasoning and RL generalize across domains but remain jagged; generalization is the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理与强化学习可跨领域泛化，但仍呈锯齿状；泛化是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware democratizes single-GPU research.
kaiser.zh: 编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件普及使单 GPU 研究民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks (hacking) outweigh existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性 AI 风险更紧迫；开源因主权原因持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as scaling; open source enables safety through scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同 Scaling（规模扩张）同等重要，开源通过审查提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are key; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升与数据质量是关键，价值转向应用层而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control and decentralization, augmenting jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需控制与去中心化，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI is not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制与垂直专业化；AGI（通用人工智能）非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需战略自主；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially, Claude's effectiveness tied to local access and tools; future not hyper-personalized software but shared tools.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初认为 Claude 的有效性依赖于本地访问和工具；未来不是超个性化软件，而是共享工具。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；重点应放在能力和安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted to using AI for tedious background tasks; biggest gap is people's understanding of what AI can do.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向使用 AI 处理繁琐的后台任务；最大的差距是人们理解 AI 能做什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Embraced asynchronous AI interaction; judge by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 拥抱异步 AI 交互；以最终影响评判，而非密切监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask; building custom hardware is accessible.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子们擅长使用 AI 因为他们没有学会不该问什么；构建定制硬件是可行的。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields superlinear gains (FP4 3x FP8).
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：芯片内部数据搬运成本超过算力；低精度带来超线性收益（FP4 是 FP8 的 3 倍）。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列减少数据搬运开销。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed builds trust.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度建立信任。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才或“破解的新人”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key in AI era.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威和愿景在 AI 时代至关重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；采用新工具前等待 6 个月。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，安全性是系统级属性，需多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO/RL add character.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练数据质量优于算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO/RL 增添个性。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽，增长转向后训练和推理缩放。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年；中国实验室擅长工程执行，而非范式创新。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents, not tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担，推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义应是智能体无人工干预持续运行的经济可行性，而非通过图灵测试等考试。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLI to GUI work surfaces (Codex, Claude Co-work); agents require human oversight and care to function.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调工作界面从命令行转向图形界面（如 Codex、Claude Co-work）；同时智能体需要人类的关注与监督才能有效运作。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to at least one agent; most work occurs in agentic environments; humans manage agents, not replaced.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我预测每个人至少会有一个智能体来委派工作，大部分工作将在智能体环境中完成；人类负责管理智能体，而非被取代。

danshipper.en: Consistent belief: AI augments humans, not replaces; human oversight and management skills become more valuable.
danshipper.zh: 始终一致的观点：AI 增强而非取代人类；人类的监督和管理技能变得更加宝贵。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in-house.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户；公司应购买 SaaS 股票，而非自行构建 AI 功能。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩展应遵循用户工作流，而非市场规模；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft are critical for final output; industry is at the start of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出至关重要；行业处于 AI 整合的起步阶段。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码的堆栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，自动驾驶 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，从而取消交通信号灯。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题；扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure over algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，零样本泛化可覆盖 500 多个城市；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车；基础设施比算法更重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 对齐问题紧迫；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；氛围编程使开发民主化。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core could be tiny, stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 预训练如同糟糕的进化；强化学习效果差；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可极小，剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle all; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source matter.
karpathy.zh: 自十二月起我未写代码，全交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥技能；智能体优先工具和开源很重要。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; LLMs are jagged ghosts; outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability drives automation.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 即提示工程；LLM 是参差不齐的幽灵；可外包思考但不可外包理解；可验证性驱动自动化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress requires deep human evaluation and avoiding reward hacking.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，并避免奖励作弊。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI can hallucinate, and doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断至关重要；AI 可能产生幻觉，医生可能因锚定效应而表现不如 AI。

edwinchen.en: AI in medicine must prioritize safety over accuracy, with omission being a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 医学 AI 必须将安全置于准确性之上，遗漏是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and taste are essential; different labs' objective functions will shape diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和品味至关重要；不同实验室的目标函数将塑造多样化的 AI 模型。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous and unnecessary.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，认为控制 AI 既危险又无必要。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习即从经验中学习，并指出学习“利于学习的表示”是首要开放问题。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年：聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年：北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 基于强化学习的后训练如今是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对 AlphaFold 等科学突破重要但非必需。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应成为全人类的工具，扩展人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有前途的路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI, with unique advantages; language models can revolutionize local education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲在 AI 领域跨越式发展，具有独特优势；语言模型可革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; no solutions yet, requiring collaboration and embracing failure.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战，尚无解决方案，需要合作并拥抱失败。

nando.en: Emphasizes human skills like communication alongside coding, and diversity/inclusion as essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 始终强调沟通等人类技能与编程并重，多样性和包容性对于有益 AI 至关重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios show craft, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；作品集展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small cross-functional teams outperform large squads; AI adoption is now baseline expectation.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型跨职能团队优于大组；采用 AI 已成为基本期望。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能；微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL likely sufficient for AGI without new architectures.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the real bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性才是瓶颈，编程是领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30 hours) expands capabilities; training pipelines remain primitive.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展能力，但训练流程仍原始。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使工具和编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型对 AGI 并非关键。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, but we need to explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，我们需要探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, especially during pre-training, can improve reasoning and yield lasting gains despite compute costs.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为强化学习（尤其是在预训练阶段）能提升推理能力，尽管算力成本高，但收益持久。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; AI should respect diverse human values and norms.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；AI 应尊重多样的人类价值观和规范。

yejin.en: Open research and democratization of AI are crucial; small models with quality data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 始终，我坚信开放研究和 AI 民主化至关重要；拥有高质量数据的小模型可以媲美前沿模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines as dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning; hire diverse archetypes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；招聘应多元化而非克隆。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative attracts talent; invest early in brand to stand out; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，指出品牌叙事是招聘利器，早期投资品牌以脱颖而出；人们因品牌而非公司加入。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; avoid structured crits; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张速度与决断优于完美；避免结构化评审；直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言需优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体常产生错误代码。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges, not just tech hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较，而非人类；现有企业面临商业模式挑战，而非仅技术障碍。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on alignment and robustness.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚未充分探索，应聚焦于对齐与鲁棒性。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督与可解释性，并认为对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: Safety culture eroded at OpenAI; post-training insufficient. Need external oversight and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，呼吁外部监督与监管。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为，由于杰文斯悖论，AI 将增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师的角色从砌砖者转变为架构师。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus on teaching real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interfaces for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他提出基础智能已足够，重点应放在教授现实世界的工程特性和人机协作的产品界面上。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual progress; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 不是突然事件，而是渐进发展；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍可延续十年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous and asynchronous experiences matter.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主；同步与异步体验都很重要。

scottwu.en: All layers of the AI stack (datacenter, labs, applications) will thrive, not just one; value accrues with differentiation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AI 栈的所有层（数据中心、实验室、应用）都会繁荣，而非仅一层；价值来自差异化。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for coding; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress, but benchmarks are poor proxies.
truell.zh: 最初，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作更好。缩放定律预测进展，但基准测试是糟糕的代理。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central. Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不非常有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放。

truell.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat. Taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 未来的编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类掌握主导权。品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost. Every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是速度和成本。Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades. Incumbents may struggle; senior engineers underrate AI, juniors over-rely.
truell.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。现有企业可能挣扎；资深工程师低估 AI，初级工程师过度依赖。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but internal workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能提升智能，但模型内部运作仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; inference costs are so low that task-specific models are unnecessary for high-value domains.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距；推理成本极低，高价值领域无需专用模型。

shazeer.en: Scaling (data, compute, and now inference) consistently improves AI; safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持扩展（数据、算力，如今包括推理）持续提升 AI；安全需要工程保障和人类监督。
